preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n-1 and at most 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w_i <= 10**9 for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge weight w_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(u_i, v_i), max(u_i, v_i)) for u_i, v_i, w_i in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The graph must not contain multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of operations required to unify the MST.
